title: Bihar BCECE-LE 2026 Mop-Up Round Counselling & Willingness Form 2026
intro: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Borad (BCECEB) has Officially Released Notice for Mop-Up Round Counselling & Willingness Form 2026 for the BCECE (LE) 2026 Lateral Entry In Second Year of Graduate Level Engineering Courses And Para-Medical, Pharmacy Courses. Exam Held On May 31, 2026 & 2nd Round Allotment Result Released OnAugust 6, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Mop-Up Round Counselling & Willingness Form 2026 Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Last Date For Apply Online : 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM)
Last Date Online Payment : 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM)
Payment Mode:    Pay Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode.
Last Date For Apply Online : 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM)
Last Date Online Payment : 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM)
Minimum Age : No Age Limit (For Graduate Engineer)
Minimum Age : 18 Years (Para-Medical & Pharmacy) as on 31/12/2026

Engineering Course Group:-  Passed Minimum THREE Years / TWO Years (Lateral & Entry) Diploma examination with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in any branch of Engineering and Technology. OR

																Passed B.Sc. Degree from a recognized University as defined by UGC, with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) and passed 10+2 examination with Mathematics as a subject. OR

																Passed D.Voc. Stream in the same or allied sector.

																(The Universities will offer suitable bridge courses such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering drawing, etc. for the students coming from diverse backgraounds to achieve desired learning outcomes of the programme).

Para Medical Degree Course Group:-  Passed in two years Para Medical Diploma Course recognized by the Government of Bihar/ Government of India for enrollment on the basis of this competitive examination in Para Medical Degree Course.
Candidates appearing in the final examination of two year Para Medical Diploma course can also apply; But it will be necessary to have passed by the time of interview/counseling.

Candidates will be considered eligible for enrollment in the second year of higher para medical degree related to the para medical degree course/course from which they have passed two year para medical diploma examination.

If higher para medical degree course is not available in the course / course from which the candidate has passed the para medical degree course / course, then such candidates will not be considered eligible to appear in this lateral entrance examination.

Pharmacy Degree Course Group:-  Passed in two years Diploma Pharmacy Course recognized by the Government of Bihar / Government of India for enrollment on the basis of this competitive examination in the Pharmacy Degree Course.
Candidates appearing in the final examination of two year pharmacy diploma course can also apply; But it will be necessary to have passed by the time of interview/counseling.
Visit the Official Website:  Go to the official BCECE Board website: https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
Click on "Apply Online" Look for the “Online Application Portal for BCECE-LE 2026” and click on it. You’ll be redirected to the registration page.
Before final submission, preview your form
